recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片可見許多核偏位、染色質呈車輪狀、細胞質略嗜雙色的漿細胞散布於間質，並有嗜酸性球與含鐵血黃素的巨噬細胞，背景間質略水腫，符合 HIV 相關反應性漿細胞增多。
features: Increased interstitial plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clock-face chromatin, and amphophilic cytoplasm
Plasma cells scattered singly and in small loose groups, not forming sheets
Scattered eosinophils with bright red granules
Loose, edematous-appearing stroma with maturing hematopoietic cells
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows increased interstitial plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clock-face chromatin, and amphophilic cytoplasm, distributed singly and in small loose groups without sheet formation. Scattered eosinophils and hemosiderin-laden macrophages are present within a loose, edematous-appearing stroma. Plasma cells appear cytologically mature. Findings are consistent with a reactive (polyclonal) plasmacytosis, as seen in HIV infection; kappa/lambda immunostaining is recommended to confirm polytypism.

ddx.vs: Myeloma shows clustered or sheet-like plasma cells with atypia and light-chain restriction on kappa/lambda staining, not scattered polytypic cells.
LPL contains a clonal population of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with MYD88 L265P, usually with IgM paraprotein.
HHV8-related lesions contain LANA-1 positive plasmablasts, which are not evident among these mature plasma cells.
Mast cells may also accompany eosinophils but have spindled or clear cytoplasm and are CD117/tryptase positive, not CD138 positive.
